newsitem.title: USA: Search, MS set merger shr ratio.
newsitem.headline: Search, MS set merger shr ratio.

text.p: Search Financial Services Inc Friday said MS Financial Inc shareholders would receive 0.3515 Search shares for each share they hold.
Search said it would issue about 3.67 million common shares based on this exchange ratio. It added it not issue fractional shares but instead will pay cash for any fractional shares.
Search said the merger agreement is subject to stockholders approval. It added stockholders meetings for both consumer finance companies are scheduled to take place on July 31.
MS Financial's two principal stockholders, who own about 77 percent of the company, have agreed to vote in favor of the merger, Search said.
Search's stock traded unchanged at 4-1/2 Friday morning, while MS Financial's stock was at 1-3/8, up 1/8.
